user.title: SHT20 sensor
user.description: Choose a name and the way the sensor is connected.

data_description.mode: tcp or udp for a Modbus gateway, rtu for a direct serial connection. Use udp when the gateway runs out of TCP connections.

data_description.host: IP address of the Modbus TCP gateway.
data_description.port: TCP port of the gateway. The default is 502.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the sensor is read.
How often the sensor is read.

udp.title: Modbus UDP

data_description.host: IP address of the Modbus TCP gateway.
data_description.port: TCP port of the gateway. The default is 502.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the sensor is read.

udp.description: UDP is connectionless, so the gateway does not limit the number of clients. There is no delivery guarantee; failed reads are retried.

init.title: SHT20 settings
init.description: Device settings and corrections. The offsets are written to the sensor itself.

data.notify_connection_errors_persistent: Notification in Home Assistant on connection loss
data.notify_recovery: Also notify when the connection is restored

data_description.device_id: Modbus address of the sensor (1-247). Changing this writes the new address to the sensor.
data_description.baudrate: Changing this writes the new baud rate to the sensor. Make sure the gateway or serial port uses the same speed afterwards.
data_description.temp_offset: Correction written to the sensor and applied by the sensor itself.
data_description.hum_offset: Correction written to the sensor and applied by the sensor itself.
data_description.multiplier: Scaling factor for the raw register value. Use 0.1 for a sensor that reports tenths.
data_description.pressure: Ambient air pressure used for the absolute humidity and enthalpy calculation. Standard atmosphere is 1013.25 hPa; lower this value at higher altitudes.
data_description.notify_connection_errors_services: Comma separated notify service names, for example mobile_app_phone. Without the service domain (so not notify.mobile_app_phone).
data_description.connection_error_delay: How long communication has to be down before a notification is sent. Prevents notifications for a short hiccup.
data_description.notify_recovery: Sends a second message as soon as the sensor can be reached again.
data_description.quiet_hours_enabled: Holds push messages during the configured period. They are sent as soon as the period ends. Notifications inside Home Assistant are never held.
data_description.quiet_hours_start: Push messages are held from this time onwards.
data_description.quiet_hours_end: Held push messages are sent at this time.

error.write_failed: Could not write the settings to the sensor. The settings have not been saved.
